---
applyTo: "**"
description: How we write documentation (Radu, for the docs sprint)
---
- Headings use sentence case: "How grades work", not "How Grades Work".
- Start every page with one sentence that says who it is for.
- Code examples use CommonJS (`const { weightedAverage } = require('./grades.js')`) so they run on any Node version.
- Show grades as percentages (7.5 becomes 75%): students understand percentages better.
- Link to the code with relative links, like [grades.js](../grades.js).
